title: AST-Route: Tail-Safe CPU-GPU-Cloud OLAP Dispatch via PCIe Margin Guarding and Zero-Compile SQL Metadata
description: Official open-source benchmark suite, frozen pre-execution GBDT routing model, 495-query row-level SQL registry (400 primary across Categories I-IV + 25 prospective OOD + 70 enterprise stress), 4-node multi-scale telemetry logs (SF = 1, 10, 30, 100 GB), and Docker replication kit accompanying the V13 manuscript submitted to Journal of Big Data.
